## Channels 
```{r}
# For each channel, create a histogram of Likert responses

plot_likert_histograms <- function(df, channel_cols, channel_labels = channel_cols,
                                   scale_values = 1:5,
                                   scale_labels = c("Never", "Rarely", "Sometimes",
                                                    "Often", "Always"),
                                   ncols = 3, normalize = TRUE) {

  stopifnot(length(channel_cols) == length(channel_labels),
            length(scale_values) == length(scale_labels))

  counts <- df %>%
    select(all_of(channel_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "channel", values_to = "response") %>%
    mutate(
      channel  = factor(channel, levels = channel_cols, labels = channel_labels),
      response = factor(response, levels = scale_values, labels = scale_labels)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(response)) %>%                  # drops NAs and values outside 1-5
    count(channel, response, .drop = FALSE) %>%   # keeps zero-count levels
    group_by(channel) %>%
    mutate(value = if (normalize) n / sum(n) else n) %>%
    ungroup()

  ggplot(counts, aes(x = response, y = value)) +
    geom_col(color = "black", fill = "steelblue") +
    facet_wrap(~ channel, ncol = ncols) +
    labs(x = "Response", y = if (normalize) "Proportion" else "Count") +
    theme_apa() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
}

df <- completed
channel_labels <- c("PBS", "Cartoon Network", "Nickelodeon",
                    "Disney Channel", "YouTube", "Netflix")
channel_cols <- c("channels_1", "channels_2", "channels_3",
                  "channels_4", "channels_5", "channels_6")

p <- plot_likert_histograms(df, channel_cols, channel_labels)
p
```

## Childhood Problematic Media Usage

```{r}
plot_diverging_likert_median <- function(df, item_cols, item_labels = item_cols,
                                         scale_values = 1:5,
                                         scale_labels = c("Strongly disagree", "Disagree",
                                                          "Neutral", "Agree", "Strongly agree"),
                                         colors = c("#B2182B", "#EF8A62", "#BDBDBD",
                                                    "#67A9CF", "#2166AC"),
                                         sort_by_agree = TRUE) {

  k <- length(scale_labels)
  m <- ceiling(k / 2)   # middle category (3 on a 5-point scale)

  stopifnot(length(item_cols) == length(item_labels),
            length(scale_values) == k,
            k %% 2 == 1,
            length(colors) == k)

  n_items <- length(item_cols)

  pct <- df %>%
    select(all_of(item_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "item", values_to = "response") %>%
    mutate(
      item     = factor(item, levels = item_cols, labels = item_labels),
      response = factor(response, levels = scale_values, labels = scale_labels)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(response)) %>%
    count(item, response, .drop = FALSE) %>%
    group_by(item) %>%
    arrange(response, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      pct       = 100 * n / sum(n),
      cum_end   = cumsum(pct),
      cum_start = cum_end - pct,
      offset    = sum(pct[seq_len(m - 1)]) + pct[m] / 2,
      xmin      = cum_start - offset,
      xmax      = cum_end - offset,
      xmid      = (xmin + xmax) / 2
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  # Item order: by % agree (highest at top) or by questionnaire order
  if (sort_by_agree) {
    item_order <- pct %>%
      group_by(item) %>%
      summarise(agree = sum(pct[as.integer(response) > m]), .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(desc(agree)) %>%
      pull(item) %>%
      as.character()
  } else {
    item_order <- as.character(levels(pct$item))
  }

  pct <- pct %>%
    mutate(y = n_items - match(as.character(item), item_order) + 1)

  # Total % disagree / agree and bar end positions
  ends <- pct %>%
    group_by(item, y) %>%
    summarise(disagree = sum(pct[as.integer(response) < m]),
              agree    = sum(pct[as.integer(response) > m]),
              left     = min(xmin),
              right    = max(xmax),
              .groups = "drop")

  # Median category = first category where cumulative percent reaches 50
  medians <- pct %>%
    group_by(item, y) %>%
    slice(which(cum_end >= 50 - 1e-9)[1]) %>%
    ungroup()

  ggplot() +
    geom_rect(data = pct,
              aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = y - 0.4, ymax = y + 0.4,
                  fill = response)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey30",
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(data = medians, aes(x = xmid, y = y),
               shape = 23, size = 4, fill = "white", color = "black", stroke = 1) +
    geom_text(data = ends,
              aes(x = left - 1, y = y, label = paste0(round(disagree), "%")),
              hjust = 1, size = 3.5, color = "grey30") +
    geom_text(data = ends,
              aes(x = right + 1, y = y, label = paste0(round(agree), "%")),
              hjust = 0, size = 3.5, color = "grey30") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(colors, scale_labels),
                      breaks = scale_labels, name = NULL) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.12)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = medians$y, labels = as.character(medians$item)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
         caption = paste0("Diamond = median response.\n",
                          "Percentages at bar ends = total disagree (left) and ",
                          "total agree (right); Neutral not included.")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
          plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0),
          plot.caption.position = "plot")
}

p <- plot_diverging_likert_median(df, item_cols, item_labels)
p
```
